classification: preregistered deepest-SDF position fine-threshold and cross-axis calibration; not an unseen geometry transfer

frozenQuestion.objective: Locate every integer primary-edge response transition inside the two sample-25 brackets and map the sample-31 cross-axis response without exceeding the observed 114-record process boundary.
frozenQuestion.liveStateRule: At each source state the base record defines the complete post-layout live tree. Every scan record must equal that base with only the declared deepest-SDF position delta, both immediately before and immediately after rendering.
frozenQuestion.responseRule: Preserve the exact signed four-edge response at each declared integer. Report transitions only between adjacent observed values with different responses; never interpolate an unsampled value.
frozenQuestion.priorAnchorRule: Compare the eight repeated responses with run 30756501856 at zero tolerance. An anchor mismatch is retained as failed transfer evidence rather than discarded or fitted away.
frozenQuestion.nullOutcome: If a declared delta is absent at the live boundary, an undeclared live field changes, a producer copy pass is missing, or an allocation invariant changes, the capture fails closed. If repeated edge responses differ, the capture remains integrity-valid but the response transfer fails.

analysisPlan.fineSample25: Partition each complete unit-step axis scan into exact response runs and report every adjacent integer transition bracket.
analysisPlan.crossAxisSample31: Partition each frozen signed coarse scan into exact response runs and report only observed brackets.
analysisPlan.repeatTransfer: Compare all eight preregistered anchors bit-exactly with the preceding calibration.
analysisPlan.modelRecovery: Only after opening the scan may candidate integerization laws be derived. Any recovered law must then pass a separately frozen unseen native-geometry transfer.
